desc: Spacious 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath townhome built in 2020 and impeccably maintained, one of three side by side homes in the desirable Springdale neighborhood of Stamford. The lower level offers a family room with a full bath, ideal as a playroom, home office, or guest bedroom. Hardwood floors, a 2 car garage, and central air complete the home. Commuters will love being 5 minutes from the Springdale train station, about 60 minutes to Grand Central, with easy access to both the Merritt Parkway and Interstate 95 and supermarkets close by. Move right in.

Relax in the enchanting courtyard with tranquil fountain surrounded by beautiful greenery. Come see this inviting sanctuary located in the heart of the sophisticated city where you can stroll to popular restaurants, bars, theater, library and shopping.
